The main takeaway from our work is that
afoxolaner, when administered to dogs, can kill P. pernicious sandflies, thus preventing them from feeding on dogs and transmitting the Leishmania parasites.
afoxolaner administered orally to dogs is highly effective in killing sandflies 48 h and 72 h following blood feeding.
afoxolaner, a new isoxazoline, is a promising new tool for the control of leishmaniasis in dogs, which may have an impact on the transmission of this disease in endemic areas.
